    Profile

    Ryle was originally an orphan boy from the slums, but through good fortune, he quickly turned into one of the richest people of the Desert Zone after becoming a guild leader. He's the lazy type who hates any sort of troublesome thing, but he has an amazing talent for orchestrating things in a way that he doesn't have to do anything himself.

    Origin: Desert Zone
    Gender: Male
    Height: 182cm
    Weight: 74kg
    Birthday: Jan 24
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Bright Knight
    Likes: Free time
    Hobbies: Lazing around on the balcony
    Illust: ―
    CV: 内田雄馬
